column3: ## Retrieve an article with multiple author affiliations via CRUD API

column1: Depends on API : CRUD Articles : Create an article with multiple author affiliations via CRUD API

column4: Response JSON contains "bibjson.author" array with 2 author objects
First author ("Jane Doe") contains "affiliations": ["University of Oxford", "Harvard University"] and "orcid_id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0001-2345-6789"
Second author ("Bob Smith") contains "affiliations": ["MIT", "Stanford University", "Cambridge University"] and "orcid_id": "https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3456-7890"
